It presents as the model getting worse mid-session: constraints it followed for an hour start slipping, it re-asks things it was told, it writes code that ignores a file it read earlier. Nothing about the model changed — the only variable is how much context it's now attending over.
It's gradual, which is what makes it hard to catch from inside the session. There's no error and no threshold; each
is only slightly worse than the last, and by the time the slips are obvious you've been in the dumb zone for a while.
You recover by removing context, not adding more. Re-pasting the ignored instruction adds another competitor to the same crowded window and helps only briefly. What works:
